Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its
entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
General information
This role offers the opportunity to have a sustainable impact on the company's Software Deployment Platform (MECM) and Windows server landscape.
 Your Key Responsibilities
 Development and Implementation:
Implement global Software Deployment solutions for Windows server landscape (currently MECM), ensuring they align with industry standards and organizational goals.
Design and architect customized global Software deployment solutions tailored to meet the needs of global Windows Server. 
Work closely with technical teams to establish robust, scalable, and efficient software deployment environments.
 Technical Leadership And Consulting
Provide expert guidance on software deployment technologies, advising clients and internal teams on best practices and cutting-edge solutions.
Serve as a technical lead in the planning and execution of software deployment projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Coordinate with global teams to standardize processes, develop technical documentation, and share knowledge.
 Management And Operations
Oversee the operation and maintenance of existing MECM environment, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.
Conduct regular performance assessments, identifying bottlenecks or inefficiencies and implementing improvements.
Analyze system metrics to proactively address potential issues before they impact users or operations.
 Support And Training
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for complex MECM issues, serving as the point of escalation for user problems.
Develop and deliver training sessions for internal teams and clients to enhance their understanding and use of software deployment solutions.
Create user guides, FAQs, and tutorials to facilitate ease of use and adoption among global users.
 Security And Compliance
Implement security protocols and measures to protect our Windows Server environments from breaches and vulnerabilities.
Ensure all software deployment implementations comply with international and industry-specific regulations and standards.
Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to continuously monitor and enhance security postures.
 Innovation And Strategy
Stay informed about the latest trends, technologies, and developments in the field of software deployment and Windows Server operating system technologies
Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their applicability to existing or new projects.
Lead strategic initiatives to enhance and expand software deployment offerings, supporting the digital transformation goals of the organization.
 Your Qualifications
At least several years of experience in the field of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) implementation and management, particularly in large, complex enterprise environments. 
Specific experience with leading technologies and platforms such as Microsoft Windows Operating System (Server), PowerShell Scripting, Azure Arc, Reporting Services, MS-SQL.
Coordination of troubleshooting processes for complex problems in collaboration with different external vendors and internal interfaces, open-minded, targeted, business thinking, customer-focused, team-player.
Operational administration experience, Project coordination experiences.
Fluent English skills (verbal and written), intercultural knowledge, good communication skills verbal and written.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and thorough referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we're committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we're happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
